findings.title: Logger no longer emits traceID and relies on FromContext
findings.body: The explicit traceID field was removed from logParams, as were pluginId, endpoint, dsName, dsUID and uname. These now come only from the contextual attributes via `m.logger.FromContext(ctx)`. The traceID is only emitted if the infra logger's FromContext adds it, which was not verified. If it does not, the 'Plugin Request Completed' log silently loses trace correlation. In addition, the wrapper's FromContext falls back to `d.New()` when the type assertion fails, which drops contextual attributes without any signal. There is no test covering the new logging output.

findings.title: Stale function name and no tests for the new middleware
findings.body: `instrumentContext` keeps the old 'instrumentation' naming even though this PR renames things for consistency. The new ContextualLoggerMiddleware has no unit test, and the metrics test no longer verifies that the contextual logger is set.

findings.title: Logger name still references instrumentation
findings.body: The logger is still named "plugin.instrumentation" even though the middleware was renamed to metrics. This is inconsistent with the stated goal of the rename, and changing the name would alter existing log filters.
